steps.title: 串列電壓：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「串列電壓」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for string voltage.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「串列電壓」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。低溫開路電壓可能高於額定工作電壓。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「用溫度係數估计電壓包絡。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for string voltage, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Cold open-circuit voltage may exceed rated operating voltage. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Estimate voltage envelopes with temperature coefficients. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 用溫度係數估计電壓包絡。
steps.observationEn: Estimate voltage envelopes with temperature coefficients.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「串列電壓」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping string voltage verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「串列電壓」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「用溫度係數估计電壓包絡。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for string voltage; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 用溫度係數估计電壓包絡。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設太陽能輸入 10 kW、效率 97%，交流輸出 9.7 kW、損失 300 W；若散熱等效 0.10 K/W，平均溫升 30 K。效率及熱阻僅為教學值，未含局部結溫與環境變化。
knowledge.textEn: For assumed 10 kW PV input at 97% efficiency, AC output is 9.7 kW and loss 300 W. At equivalent thermal resistance 0.10 K/W, mean rise is 30 K; junction hot spots and environment variation are omitted.
